name: Alcove
tagline: A quiet room you can set down anywhere on the floor: for calls, focus work and meetings of up to eight, with light, air and power built in.
about: Alcove is a family of modular, free-standing booths — a value-driven alternative to building walls. Each model is self-contained, with LED lighting, silent ventilation and power, and cuts surrounding noise by 32 dB. It installs quickly, without building work, and moves or packs down when the floor plan changes.
builtIn: LED overhead lighting with a motion sensor, silent overhead ventilation fans, and a power socket and USB charging port at worksurface height

details.title: The models
lines: Alcove Solo — a one-person booth for calls and short focus work, with a built-in shelf; stand, or add a high stool.
Alcove Focus — a roomier single booth with a full table and a task chair, for work that needs files and a laptop. Solid acoustic or glass back wall.
Alcove Duo — two or three seats at a bar-height shelf along the back wall, for joint calls, interviews and quick breaks.
Alcove Huddle — a meeting booth for two, four or six on chairs or sofas, with a laminate tabletop.
Alcove Team — the largest, for four, six or eight, with room for sofas, a whiteboard or a screen.

details.title: Acoustics
lines: Fire-rated acoustic board, carpet and polyester foam line the walls; sound-absorbing felt inside.

details.title: Construction
lines: All-metal structure in 1.2 mm electro-galvanised steel.
Single-glazed 8 mm tempered glass door and back wall; the door locks.
80 to 100% of the materials can be recycled at the end of its life.

details.title: Installation and safety
lines: Plug and play: usable as soon as it is set up, and it can be moved, taken apart and stored.
Building sprinklers reach inside through the overhead panel.
Optional tie-down straps hold it to the floor for earthquake safety.

name: VOLT & BOLT pop-up box
tagline: Power and data that rise out of the desk top when you need them and close flush when you don't.
about: Set into the top of a workstation or a conference table, the pop-up box opens to sockets, USB charging, data and video, and closes back into a flat lid. Soft-open hydraulic versions take a set number of modules and can be fitted to the run.
builtIn: Universal sockets, USB-A and USB-C charging, data, HDMI, audio — depending on the model
finish: Silver or black; customisable boxes also in white, grey, brass and stainless steel
